unit.why: A short anecdote, told by the author's father: before the wedding of R. Avraham Yaakov of Sadigura, his father R. Israel of Ruzhin blessed him and spoke of his own father and of his children.
unit.boundary_note: The closing words 'שיחותיו ותורותיו הקדושים.' are a section heading that belongs to the next division.

stories.start_quote: סיפר לי אדוני אבי מו״ר הרה״צ זצ"ל
stories.end_quote: גייא צו דער חופה אין א גיטער שעה
stories.summary_en: Before the wedding of R. Avraham Yaakov of Sadigura, his father R. Israel of Ruzhin blessed him: R. Shalom Shakhna had said his children would show who he was, but Israel says his children will show who God is, and he tells his son he chose him a very holy soul as a bride.

quotes: לפני חופתו של מרן הרה״ק רא"י מס"ג
גייא צו דער חופה אין א גיטער שעה
tags.why: The blessing is given at the son's wedding
